title: Stratum telemetry (STR-242)
description: Outcome series (OTel-shaped, via the authenticated collector into the client-log BigQuery sink), exceptional-occurrence counter (Analytics BigQuery export), and Crashlytics issue velocity (Crashlytics BigQuery export). Import: Grafana Dashboards > Import, paste this file. Replace the PROJECT./DATASET/PROPERTY placeholders per gcp/grafana/README.md (single vocabulary: PROJECT.DATASET.client_log_sink, PROJECT.analytics_PROPERTY).

panels.title: Outcome volume by use case and outcome

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time, jsonPayload.tag AS use_case, jsonPayload.outcome AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.client_log_sink` WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND jsonPayload.source = 'stratum-client-log' AND jsonPayload.severity = 'OUTCOME' GROUP BY time, use_case, outcome ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time, jsonPayload.tag AS use_case, SUM(IF(jsonPayload.outcome = 'expected_failure', 1, 0)) / COUNT(*) AS failure_rate FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.client_log_sink` WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND jsonPayload.source = 'stratum-client-log' AND jsonPayload.severity = 'OUTCOME' GROUP BY time, use_case ORDER BY time

panels.title: Exceptional-occurrence counter rate (Analytics export)
panels.description: Bare exceptional_occurred counts for real-time exceptional-rate alerting; issue detail lives in Crashlytics (panel 5).

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), MINUTE) AS time, (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'boundary') AS boundary, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `PROJECT.analytics_PROPERTY.events_*` WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', CURRENT_DATE()) AND event_name = 'exceptional_occurred' GROUP BY time, boundary ORDER BY time

panels.title: Outcome pipeline freshness
panels.description: Minutes since the newest OUTCOME row. A rising value means the collector path (not necessarily the app) needs attention; compare with the CollectorErrors alert before paging.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), MAX(timestamp), MINUTE) AS minutes_since_last_outcome FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.client_log_sink` WHERE jsonPayload.source = 'stratum-client-log' AND jsonPayload.severity = 'OUTCOME'

panels.title: Crashlytics issue velocity (fill in after export enablement)
panels.description: TEMPLATE: enable the Crashlytics BigQuery export, list the dataset tables, and replace CRASHLYTICS_DATASET plus the table/columns below. Grafana sees issue-level rows (grouping happens in Crashlytics before export).

targets.rawSql: SELECT issue_id, issue_title, event_count, user_count FROM `PROJECT.CRASHLYTICS_DATASET.CRASHLYTICS_TABLE` WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp) ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 50
